Personal Assistant Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited is the most sought-after Human Resource Solution Provider with its Head Office in Lagos, Nigeria. We have a reputation for satisfying and surpassing clients' expectations through our core offerings: Recruitment and Selection, Outsourcing, Training and Development. To accomplish these we leverage creating and managing change in organizations by improving efficiency through our proven and dynamic HR solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Personal Assistant
Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and discreet Personal Assistant to provide administrative and executive support to the President's Office.
	The ideal candidate will possess excellent organizational, communication, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining confidentiality.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage the President's calendar, appointments, meetings, and travel arrangements.
	Prepare correspondence, reports, presentations, and meeting minutes.
	Screen calls, emails, and visitors, ensuring timely follow-up and response.
	Coordinate meetings, events, and other executive engagements.
	Organize and maintain confidential files, records, and documents.
	Liaise with internal departments and external stakeholders on behalf of the President.
	Track tasks, deadlines, and follow up on action items.
	Perform other administrative duties as assigned.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree (B.Sc. / B.A.) or HND in any relevant discipline.
	2–5 years of experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, or in a similar administrative role.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving abilities.
	High level of professionalism, integrity, and confidentiality.
	Ability to work independently and under pressure.


Salary
N300,000 - N350,000 monthly.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Confidential Secretary",
  "description": "De Potter College of Health Technology is a privately owned institution located along the Oru/Ijebu-Igbo road in Oru-Ijebu, Ogun State, Nigeria. Founded in 2014, the college is approved by the Ogun State Ministry of Education, Science and Technology and holds an operational license from the Federal Ministry of Education. It is fully accredited by the National Board for Technical Education (NBTE) alongside various national healthcare professional boards.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Confidential Secretary

Job Location: Km2 Oru/Ijebu-Igbo Road, Oru-Ijebu, Ogun

Requirements


	HND or B.Sc. in Secretarial Studies, Office Technology and Management (OTM), or a related field.

Job Summary
     

            
    




	As the Digital Communication Officer, you will play a pivotal role in creating and delivering highly engaging content across our digital channel, including our website, blog, email marketing, and social media platform
	Your core mission is to drive brand visibility and generate premium sales leads.


Key Roles & Responsibilities


	Content Creation & Storytelling: Craft and publish compelling stories, videos, and visual narratives that highlight our premium craftsmanship. Capture daily factory floor production, showroom setups, and installation projects.
	Campaign & Calendar Planning: Plan, execute, and manage monthly content calendars and digital campaigns to drive platform traffic, follower growth, and brand loyalty.
	Brand Strategy & Consistency: Establish a cohesive visual and messaging identity across all digital touchpoints. Align online branding with offline showroom experiences and conduct quarterly brand audits.
	Audience Engagement: Monitor platforms daily to engage with our audience, fostering community loyalty. Ensure all online inquiries are addressed with a maximum 24-hour response time.
	Performance Analytics & Reporting: Track, analyze, and deliver monthly reports on digital campaign performances using Google Analytics, Meta Insights, and other evaluation tools, adjusting strategies to optimize KPIs.
	Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with the Production, Showroom Sales, and Project Teams to source impactful narratives and integrate communication materials seamlessly.


Requirements & Qualifications


	Education: Minimum of an HND or Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience in a dedicated digital marketing role).
	Experience: 1 – 2 years of active experience in digital marketing, social media management, creative content creation, and basic graphic design.


Technical Skills:


	Proficiency in handling photography/videography equipment.
	Intermediate to advanced skills in mobile and desktop creative tools (e.g., Canva, InShot, Adobe Photoshop, CapCut, etc.).
	Hands-on experience managing and running campaigns across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, YouTube, and email marketing platforms.
	Solid understanding of digital metrics and tracking software (e.g., Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite).
	Core Attributes: Exceptional organizational and time management skills, a keen eye for aesthetic detail, strong creative flair, and the ability to manage multiple concurrent project timelines smoothly.


Salary
N150,000 - N200,000 monthly. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their updated CV and a link to their creative portfolio (showing previous content creation, video edits, or social media management work) to: [email protected] using “Digital Communication Officer” as the subject of the email.
